attack_quote: The core weakness was that our service-mesh sidecar did not scale up, together with our retry behavior, and clients were not bound enough to keep a partial degradation from amplifying into a broader overload.

contributing_factors.source_quote: As requests backed up, several of the datacenter’s load-balancer nodes exhausted their network flow limits, which degraded the shared gateway authentication path and produced widespread authentication latency and failures across the many services that route through that datacenter.
contributing_factors.text: Several of the datacenter’s load-balancer nodes exhausted their network flow limits, which degraded the shared gateway authentication path and produced widespread authentication latency and failures.

contributing_factors.source_quote: A latent client retry bug sharply amplified traffic to one internal authentication endpoint, which slowed recovery for the Copilot Token Service.
contributing_factors.text: A latent client retry bug sharply amplified traffic to one internal authentication endpoint, slowing recovery for the Copilot Token Service.

contributing_factors.source_quote: The core weakness was that our service-mesh sidecar did not scale up, together with our retry behavior, and clients were not bound enough to keep a partial degradation from amplifying into a broader overload.
contributing_factors.text: Service-mesh sidecar did not scale up together with retry behavior, and clients were not sufficiently bounded, allowing partial degradation to amplify into broader overload.

fixes.source_quote: Correct autoscaling policies so they account for service-mesh sidecar concurrency and capacity, not just the host service.
fixes.text: Correct autoscaling policies so they account for service-mesh sidecar concurrency and capacity, not just the host service.

fixes.source_quote: Audit request, concurrency, and scaling limits for the service mesh across the affected services.
fixes.text: Audit request, concurrency, and scaling limits for the service mesh across the affected services.

fixes.source_quote: Review retry and backoff limits across gateways and clients so a partial degradation cannot be amplified into a broader overload.
fixes.text: Review retry and backoff limits across gateways and clients to prevent amplification of partial degradations.

fixes.source_quote: Fix the client retry behavior that amplified authentication traffic during the incident.
fixes.text: Fix the client retry behavior that amplified authentication traffic during the incident.

fixes.source_quote: Improve load-balancer capacity monitoring and strengthen regional failover safeguards.
fixes.text: Improve load-balancer capacity monitoring and strengthen regional failover safeguards.

root_cause.source_quote: A new peak in traffic pushed one datacenter’s load balancers past their limits. A service-mesh sidecar reached its concurrency limit and did not scale up.
root_cause.text: A new peak in traffic pushed one datacenter’s load balancers past their limits and a service-mesh sidecar reached its concurrency limit and did not scale up, causing network flow exhaustion and degraded shared authentication paths.

timeline.event: The incident begins; front-door requests to many services fail or run slow.
The incident ends: 13:40 UTC plus the stated 7 hours and 35 minutes (the impact summary gives about 6 hours 44 minutes).
